CLMA No.9881/2018 (Delay Codonation Application in Counter Affidavit) 
IN 
WPSS No.892 of 2018 
Hon’ble V.K. Bist, J.
Mr. Anil Anthwal, Advocate for 
the petitoner. 
Mr. S.K. Mishra, Standing 
Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand. 
Delay in filing the counter 
affidavit is condoned. Delay 
condonation application thus stands 
disposed of. Counter affidavit filed on 
behalf of respondent no.4 is taken on 
record. 
As prayed, four weeks’ time is 
granted to the learned counsel for the 
petitioner to file rejoinder affidavit. 
List this matter on 04.09.2018. 
In the meantime, respondent no.5 
may file counter affidavit. 
 (V.K. Bist, J.)
